patterns.note: Frequent use of a highly vibrant, almost neon, color palette (pink, yellow, green) as primary accents against deeper maroon/brown or white backgrounds, creating a playful and energetic contrast.
Large, bold, and condensed sans-serif headings are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, often incorporating playful, slightly irregular baselines or kerning for emphasis.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, while the top navigation bar transforms from a transparent, larger state to a compact, sticky header with a solid yellow background after initial scroll.
Distinctive wavy, organic-shaped dividers are used consistently to visually separate and frame many content sections, adding a playful and unique brand element.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations (likely using locomotive-scroll or similar libraries) to create a dynamic scrolling experience. The initial hero section scrolls out of view, revealing subsequent content sections that animate into place with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport. The top navigation bar transitions from a transparent, larger state to a compact, sticky header with a solid background after the user scrolls past the initial hero. Distinctive wavy section dividers also appear to animate or reveal as they come into view.

Playful, hand-drawn graphic elements like starbursts and badges are integrated into the design to highlight key information or calls to action, often with a slight tilt or irregular placement to enhance the whimsical feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful, condensed sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text size) are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements, but overall mostly sharp edges for main content blocks; product packaging features soft, organic curves.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding in hero sections and between major content blocks, while product grids maintain a denser arrangement.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly vibrant, almost neon, color palette combined with playful, hand-drawn graphic elements (like starbursts and wavy dividers) creates a unique, energetic, and approachable brand identity. The bold, condensed typography further reinforces this playful yet confident tone, making the product feel fun and modern.
